scope: Actual RewardCatalog, RewardLedger and RewardStore execute with real host JSON parsing. Android Context/SharedPreferences I/O is simulated, including failed writes/restart. Includes prior wallet checks and focused native-ad-token grant policy. This is not evidence of Google SDK callbacks, consent, Android persistence or gameplay.

adRewardPolicy.proof: Only a native SDK earned callback may request credit.
adRewardPolicy.identity: One pending UUID persisted before show; fixed credit and identity removal commit together.
adRewardPolicy.duplicates: Nonmatching, cancelled and previously credited identities are no-ops.
adRewardPolicy.restart: Unproven pending attempts remain unpaid; controller explicitly cancels stale attempts.
adRewardPolicy.failure: Failed writes roll back balance and token; retrying retained earned proof pays once.
